logo.note: Tight crop (3% pad) of the business's own 1920x1080 JPEG lockup with tagline, saved as an opaque white-background PNG (1896x1065). No transparent or vector original exists.

card.alt: Buffet spread with a crate-mounted tray of parmesan-dusted arancini, mini pizzette on a log slice, cured-meat platters and fries

gallery.alt: Garden BBQ buffet on a hessian-covered table: brioche burgers on log stands, a chafing dish of sliced steak, salads, corn, a framed menu card and a sunflower arrangement.

Buffet spread in a hall: a crate-mounted tray of parmesan-dusted arancini, mini pizzette on a log slice, cured-meat platters with cornichons and olives, skin-on fries, pesto pasta salad and green salad.
Italian Feast antipasti: rows of wooden paddles with mortadella, salami, mozzarella, pickled peppers and olives, arancini in terracotta dishes, focaccia and heritage tomato salads on a black counter.
Go Greek sharing meze from above: grilled flatbreads, houmous with crispy chickpeas, tzatziki, htipiti, marinated olives, village salad, grilled halloumi with pomegranate and calamari with lemon.
Long BBQ buffet beside a marquee: meatballs and chicken skewers in crate-mounted chafing dishes, corn on the cob, flatbreads, slaws, salads and dips on hessian with eucalyptus.
Outdoor BBQ desserts on hessian: an Essex mess platter with strawberries, blueberries and pink meringues, chocolate orange mousse pots on a log slice and strawberry-topped cheesecake squares.

Buffet desserts: profiteroles with chocolate sauce and coconut, salted caramel brownies topped with toffee popcorn on log slices, and a platter of grapes, strawberries, pineapple, melon and raspberries.
Outdoor buffet table: pizzette, feta and rocket flatbread tart slices on a board, honey-glazed chipolatas, savoury rice, roast potatoes, a bread basket, vegetable skewers and dried-grass posies.
Christmas roast dinner table: plates of pink roast beef with Yorkshire puddings and roast potatoes, pigs in blankets, cauliflower cheese, mash, a gravy jug, red wine, candles and berried foliage.

notes: Logo: kind=raster. The only logo files are JPEGs on white. Vector tracing was tried with scripts/media/logo_trace.py at 2, 3 and 4 colours (render-back mean absolute difference 14.17, 14.17 and 8.35; the 4-colour trace turned the charcoal text grey and kept a grey background plate) and with a custom per-brand-colour potrace layering (diff 3.84, 319 KB). The custom trace reads correctly at a glance but flattens the weatherboard wood-grain on the farmhouse walls and coarsens the roof hatching, so it was not judged faithful and was not shipped. Plate 'light': show the mark on a white tile.

Reel: six still segments from the business's own 2560/2048 px photos with a gentle push-in; sources, order and timings are in reel.json. The only own video (video-output-1D3E447A...mov, 19.6 s, 1620x1080, a portrait phone clip pillarboxed with blurred bars) is a beat-cut Christmas box unboxing/cooking montage: ffmpeg scdet at threshold 2 finds cuts roughly every 0.6 s (longest shot about 1.2 s), so no 2.0-3.0 s clip exists inside a single shot and no video clip was used. Its audio was never used.

Gallery: nine of the business's own photos from thefarmhouseessex.com (homepage, BBQ menu, private chef, buffet packages and Christmas boxes pages), resized to 2000 px square (photo-09 is 1536 px, its source size), WebP quality 82. Alt texts describe the food shown; dish names follow the business's own menu wording.

Excluded: Staff-Service-.jpg (identifiable wedding guests and staff, flagged in the research); Serviced-Buffet-Wedding.jpg (identifiable chef, 1400 px, alt text names a person); serviced-buffet.jpg (near-duplicate of the buffet theme already covered by photo-02 and photo-08); the four logo JPEGs. No stock, AI or third-party imagery was used.
Card: 4:3 crop (y 15%-90% of the square) of the homepage Buffet.jpg, 1200x900.
